title: Military aircraft to fly over campus Friday morning in advance of Oct. 24 football game
summary_en: U.S. military aircraft will fly over the Lawrence campus Friday, Oct. 23, in advance of the Oct. 24 football game between the University of Kansas and Baylor University.
title_cn: Military aircraft to fly over campus Friday morning in advance of Oct. 24 football game

title: KU Libraries name 2026 Shulenburger Award recipients, honor contributions to open scholarship
summary_en: Michael Vitevitch and Emily Casey, two University of Kansas faculty members whose work expands access to scholarship through public engagement, open publishing and research resources, have been named recipients of the 2026 Shulenburger Award for Innovation and Advocacy in Scholarly Communication by KU Libraries.
title_cn: KU Libraries name 2026 Shulenburger Award recipients, honor contributions to open scholarship
